text:
maya: Heads-up — when the console is at 375px the left rail collapsed to icons causes the table ellipsis to 'bounce' visually when tapped, looks like a z-index / transform repaint issue.

noah: repro? browser?

maya: iPhone 8 / Safari; go to Jobs > Recent > try to open kebab quickly on multiple rows, sometimes the rail flickers and the menu appears in the wrong place. Short recording: https://redwood-internal/clip/rail-flicker.mp4

cecil: sounds like we have both stacking and GPU transform issues. We used translateZ on the rail for perf; maybe that creates a new stacking context.

tara: quick options: 1) remove translateZ and rely on will-change: transform sparingly, 2) force higher z-index on popovers and anchors, 3) switch to a centered popover to avoid edge collisions.

noah: also a touch-target problem: the kebab is only 28px on compact rows. We should ensure interactive targets are 44px minimum on touch.

maya: I sketched a small change: keep rail icons but add 6px extra hit padding and change the popover attachment to document.body so it isn't clipped by the rail. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/Unique/console-touch-narrow

cecil: dev snippet to test reverting translateZ:
```css
.app-rail { will-change: auto; transform: none; }
.popover { position: absolute; z-index: 30; }
.row .kebab { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; }
```

tara: please add visual regression snapshots at 320/375/414 widths. Also add a quick VoiceOver test to confirm menu is announced and focus traps correctly.

visual-tests-bot: Visual snapshots queued: builds/7712/rail-flicker-375.png ✅

noah: cool — i'll open a small PR with z-index + hit target fix + popover to body. tagging @cecil for perf check.

maya: thanks — filing follow-ups in the design board.
